tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Cargo Tracker is a Jakarta EE sample showing Domain-Driven Design for cargo shipping: booking, routing, and tracking cargo.

tour.title: Core Aggregate: Cargo
tour.description: The Cargo aggregate root is the heart of the domain, identified by TrackingId and holding route specification, itinerary and delivery state.

tour.title: Handling Events
tour.description: HandlingEvents record what happens to cargo; the factory validates and builds them, and HandlingHistory aggregates them.

tour.title: Locations and Voyages
tour.description: Supporting aggregates: Location (UN/LOCODE) and Voyage with its schedule of carrier movements.

tour.title: Repositories and Domain Services
tour.description: The domain declares repository interfaces and the RoutingService contract, keeping it independent of persistence.

tour.title: Specification Pattern
tour.description: Shared specification classes allow composable business rules with and/or/not.

tour.title: Application Services
tour.description: Application services orchestrate use cases: booking, handling registration and cargo inspection.

tour.title: Persistence Infrastructure
tour.description: JPA repositories implement domain repository interfaces.

tour.title: Routing and Pathfinder
tour.description: ExternalRoutingService adapts the separate pathfinder API for computing itineraries.

tour.title: Messaging with JMS
tour.description: Application events flow over JMS to consumers that react to handled, delivered and misdirected cargo.

tour.title: Booking UI and Facade
tour.description: JSF backing beans use a booking facade with DTO assemblers to isolate the UI from the domain.

tour.title: Tracking and Real-time Updates
tour.description: Public tracking pages, REST monitoring and WebSocket push show cargo status.

tour.title: Handling Event Ingestion
tour.description: Events enter via REST, mobile and batch file processing, becoming registration attempts.

tour.title: Sample Data and Utilities
tour.description: Sample data generation and REST config bootstrap the demo.
